documents.text: simulated-vision-small-v1 is a simulator-only vision model with declared quality 0.95. No hardware validation is claimed.
The local simulator starts on edge-a in eu-gr. cloud-a is in eu-de. Tenant residency and node capacity are checked by deterministic policy.
Scale and migration proposals require a separate human approver credential in the Phase 3 workflow. Approval never overrides the deterministic policy gate.
For a simulated latency incident, inspect the telemetry snapshot, candidate rejection reasons, predicted recovery time, and post-action verification. Use no-op when no safe action exists.
Tenant-a local demo note: review simulated vision service scale proposals before approval.
